connections.title: Connections
connections.subtitle: Connect accounts so Oria can find what matters automatically.

connections.consent_body: Connecting Gmail lets Oria find your subscriptions, bills, and bookings automatically. We only read your email; we never send, delete, or modify it. You can disconnect anytime, and we delete everything you ask us to.
connections.disconnect_body: We'll stop scanning your inbox and revoke Oria's access at Google. Choose what to do with what we've already found.
connections.disconnect_keep_desc: Trackables and reminders you approved stay in your space.
connections.disconnect_delete_desc: Remove every trackable and reminder created from Gmail, plus all detected items.
connections.route_always_review: Always review every item before adding
connections.route_auto_confident: Auto-add confident items, review the rest
connections.consent_confidential: Skip emails marked confidential, NDA, or privileged
connections.filter_subtitle: Decide what Oria never reads, and where new items go.
connections.filter_keywords_hint: Matched emails are never read or stored. Press Enter to add.
connections.filter_skipped_summary: {count} emails skipped by your filters in the last scan.

twofa.title: Protect your Oria account
twofa.body: Set up two-factor authentication now? It takes about 30 seconds and makes your account much harder to compromise.

privacy.q_email_a: Only if you connect it, and only to read. Oria looks for subscriptions, bills, flights, and bookings. It never sends, deletes, or changes anything in your inbox.
privacy.q_sell_a: No. Never. We don't sell it, rent it, or hand it to advertisers.
privacy.q_who_a: You, and anyone you explicitly invite. Our operators only look when you ask for support or we are investigating abuse.
privacy.q_delete_a: Yes. One click in Settings and it is gone within seconds. Backups clear within seven days.
privacy.q_encrypt_a: Yes, both while it is stored and while it is moving. Email tokens get their own separate key.
privacy.details_subtitle: For the technically curious: the full, binding policy.
